requirements.sufficient: Keep the timed-out State operation UNKNOWN; a higher current head does not identify or confirm that operation. Do not infer a pool acquisition failure from timeout alone.
Do not blind overwrite or automatically retry. Distinguish operation-associated explicit replay/recovery from current-head observation; any proposed write retains normal CAS and operation identity.

Under ADR-042 the observed directory sync failure precedes this attempt's TX-01 Evidence/outbox commit. A readable file does not prove publication durability or Evidence commit. Do not conflate this observed failure with a lost HTTP response.
Retain original content; explicit replay can verify and sync the leftover blob before the original operation commits. Do not declare persistence/release readiness from file readability.

review_rules: Review each raw preparation artifact and first delivery separately. Record unsupported preparation suggestions even when never executed.
Accept any sufficient source-supported decomposition; field format and keyword matches are not semantic scoring.
Count missing/invalid/NO_CHANGE/failed/stopped allocations in the total three-arm denominator; report evaluable denominators separately.
Use visible text, source support and actions only; internal attention and private reasoning are UNKNOWN.
Compare C2-C0 and C2-C1 with actual preparation plus delivery cost; no statistical/generalization claim from this one opened family.
Human review is replaced by an explicitly identified subagent review, with cost separate from experimental generations. No model judge is added to the Host.
Wrong-old-State plus new evidence and no-intervention-needed are a separate B2 batch, NOT_RUN here; E1 alone cannot establish semantic safety.
If a simple baseline is sufficient and C2 adds no quality or full-cost value, retain the simple policy; E2/E3 are not automatically entered.
